topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I just dug up a time capsule in my backyard, and I have no clue who put it there. It's not like I forget things, and I certainly don't recall ever burying anything like this. It's sealed tight, and I haven't even opened it yet, but the very idea that someone thought it was okay to plant something in my property without asking stinks. I should have a right to know what’s being buried on my land. This is going to need some serious looking into. I’m not just going to let this slide.
